Looking for a sentimental Christmas gift for grandparents who live far away? The Vocalia Recordable Message Bottle is a mini Christmas tree bottle with a built-in voice recorder, so mom, dad and the kids can each record a loving message telling grandma and grandpa how much they miss them, and they can listen to it again every holiday season. It works as a Christmas ornament and a keepsake gift in one, a heartfelt idea for families who are miles apart and want to keep Christmas memories close. Record it, pull the cork and let them hear the voices they love.
